## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Related issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or option
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactoring with no change in behaviour
- [ ] Build, tooling or dependency change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (type-check, lint, formatting, unit and
      integration tests, build).
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for changed behaviour. A bug fix includes a
      test that fails without it.
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` and `README.md` matches the new behaviour.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`.
- [ ] No runtime dependency was added.

## Effect on guarantees

Tick any that apply, and explain below.

- [ ] Changes how a verification result (clean, changes detected, incomplete,
      untrusted) is determined.
- [ ] Changes the baseline format, the JSON report or the exit codes.
- [ ] Changes how files, paths or configuration are read or written.
- [ ] None of the above.

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything that needs particular attention, trade-offs made, or follow-up work.
